combo_label: The Pub × Camping & the Outdoors × Harry Potter

entries.clue: Hooked metal spike hammered into turf to hold the canvas down
Plain room of the old divided house, where the beer cost less
Cash drawer behind the bar, ringing each time it slides open
Goblin-run bank whose deepest vaults lie behind a dragon
Long-snouted burrower with a passion for anything that glitters
Lidded tin pot slung over flames to boil up water on the trail
Sneering pale-haired schoolmate, and a dragon in the stars
Small whisky, in the word a Scot would use for it
Nylon room on poles, pitched for a night in a field
Magnetised needle swinging in its dial, settling on north to fix a walker's bearing
